claim: Church-encoded arithmetic is a practical way to express a money-sum check as a Sigma-Glyph term.

environment.what: Sigma-Glyph Book I v0.5 evaluator, Profile C1 compiler

measurement.value: Church ~2.05e12 (about 61 per unit of magnitude) versus positional 61,479
measurement.method: measured on the reference evaluator; Church cost extrapolated from a linear fit over magnitudes 200..400

counterexample.means: Church encoding projects past 1e11 ATP at the case magnitude

negative_control.means: the positional encoding of the same claim stays under the budget

applies_until: An evaluator memoises repeated subterm evaluation, or a numeral encoding with sublinear cost in magnitude is published.
